task.name: Close_cheese_station
task.when: At the end of cheese service

step.action: Measure remaining protected cheese with 🍷 Food_Probe_Thermometer.
Separate protected cheese at or below 41°F from exposed, warmer, or unknown cheese.
Put exposed, warmer, or unknown cheese and exposed crackers in 📦 Trash_Bins.
Wrap protected cheese that remained at or below 41°F with 🍷 Plastic_Wrap.
Put the wrapped protected cheese in the refrigerator.
Return unopened crackers to dry storage.
Fill each of 🍷 Three_Wash_Basins from 🔧 Fresh_Water_Tank with the minimum water needed to submerge the largest item.
Add 🍷 Dish_Soap to the first basin according to its label.
Add 🍷 Sanitizer_Tablets to the third basin according to their label.
Measure the third basin with 🍷 Sanitizer_Test_Strips.
step.ifThen: IF the result is outside 200–400 ppm, THEN adjust according to the sanitizer label and test again.

step.action: Wash each knife, cutting board, tray, grid, mat, tong, and thermometer probe in the first basin.
Rinse each washed item in the second basin.
Sanitize each rinsed item in the third basin for the label's contact time.
Place each sanitized item on 🍷 Drying_Rack to air dry.
Put fully dry items in 🍷 Cheese_Station_Storage.
Move all used basin water into 🔧 Gray-Water_IBC.
Clean and sanitize 🍷 Cheese_Work_Surface with 🍷 Food_Surface_Sanitizer according to its label.

passWhen.criterion: No exposed cheese or cracker was returned to storage.
Only protected cheese held at or below 41°F was wrapped and refrigerated.
Every reusable food-contact item was washed, rinsed, sanitized, air-dried, and stored.
The work surface is clean and sanitized.
No wash water or sanitizer reached the playa.

problem.condition: The time or temperature history of remaining cheese is unknown.
problem.response: Do not refrigerate it for later service. Put it in 📦 Trash_Bins.

reasoning.entry: The workbook says to refrigerate any remaining cheese, but current food-safety guidance does not support saving exposed food with unknown time or temperature history.
